component.name: Konvert
component.summary: High-performance file converter and optimizer for Linux and KDE Plasma

description.p: Konvert is an ultra-fast, lightweight, offline, and native file conversion and optimization utility crafted for Linux and KDE Plasma.

ul.li: Dolphin Context Menu Integration: Convert photos, videos, audio, and documents directly from the right-click menu without opening heavy applications.
Privacy-first and 100% Offline: Zero telemetry and zero cloud dependencies; all files are converted locally using native system resources.
Multi-threaded Performance: Powered by Rust and Rayon to batch-process hundreds of files in parallel.
Smart Target Sizing: Automatically optimize videos and images for Discord (8 MB limit), email attachments (25 MB limit), and the web.
Media and Document Support: Convert between WebP, PNG, JPEG, AVIF, JXL, MP4, WebM, MKV, GIF, MP3, WAV, UDF, and PDF.
Conversion History and Savings: Track space savings, view preview thumbnails, and quickly open files in Dolphin.

description.p: Release 0.2.0 with KDE Plasma 6 integration, native progress notifications, smart target sizing presets, and history preview.
